title: Parallel capital actions: vote-tabulation and board certification pack
instructions: Using the hypothetical meeting records and only the Luxembourg corpus, prepare memo.md for a group board secretary. Calculate separate SA and SARL statutory-amendment voting results, distinguish votes expressed from total capital, identify assumptions and missing formal evidence, and draft a conditional rather than fabricated completion certification. Also address a separate SCS proposal without importing either corporate threshold. Show arithmetic and cite rules.

scope.companyForm: SA, ordinary SARL and SCS parallel capital proposals
